description: This Dart source file defines a class 'SupabaseConfig' responsible for configuring and initializing the Supabase client within a Flutter application. It includes methods for URL normalization, validation, connectivity checks, environment variable loading, and retry logic for establishing a connection.

classes.name: SupabaseConfig
classes.description: A utility class for managing Supabase client initialization, URL validation, connectivity checks, and connection status reporting within a Flutter app.

methods.name: _normalizeUrl
methods.description: Normalizes and ensures the URL uses HTTPS and has no trailing slashes.

methods.name: _validateUrl
methods.description: Validates the URL format, ensuring it starts with 'https://', contains '.supabase.co', and is a valid URI.

methods.name: _checkConnectivity
methods.description: Checks whether the provided URL is reachable by performing an HTTP HEAD request.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads environment variables, validates the Supabase URL and key, checks connectivity, and attempts to initialize the Supabase client with retry logic.
